## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see implemented.

## 💡 Motivation
Why are you requesting this feature? What problem does it solve?

## 🎯 Use Cases
Describe the specific use cases for this feature.

## 📱 Platform Support
Which platforms should this feature support?
- [ ] Android
- [ ] iOS
- [ ] Web
- [ ] Windows
- [ ] macOS
- [ ] Linux

## 🔧 Implementation Details
Any specific implementation details or technical considerations.

## 🎨 UI/UX Design
Any specific UI/UX requirements or design considerations.

## 📋 Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📚 Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.

## 📊 Priority
- [ ] Low - Nice to have
- [ ] Medium - Important but not urgent
- [ ] High - Important and somewhat urgent
- [ ] Critical - Urgent, blocks other work

## ✅ Checklist
- [ ] I have searched for existing feature requests
- [ ] I have provided sufficient detail for implementation
- [ ] I have considered edge cases and limitations
